title: Long term course and outcome of first episode schizophrenia: a 27-to-31-year follow-up
cohort_overlap_notes: Same IUSMM East-end Montreal incidence cohort as Nicole 1992 (baseline, n=145) and Abdel-Baki 2011 (10-16 year follow-up); neither of those reports is in the frozen screening set.
notes: Cohort triage hint CONFIRMED. Occupational status observed for 43 of the 108 alive at 27-31 years; 6 held jobs on the regular market. The abstract's 'From 15 to 25% might have been employed' is an extrapolation from medication-insurance coverage and is NOT extracted, as the manifest note directs. Follow-up runs from individual first admissions in 1983-1987 to one common end date (2014), so followup_basis is calendar_end_common (D12.8) - a point the triage note did not carry.

title: Comparison of focused cognitive training and portable “brain-games” on functional outcomes for vocational rehabilitation participants
cohort_overlap_notes: Two recruitment sites (64 veterans at VA Connecticut Healthcare System, 13 non-veterans at Connecticut Mental Health Center) under one protocol, one set of entry criteria and one randomisation; coded as ONE cohort, not two, so prompt rule 11 does not apply. Registered as NCT00829400.
notes: Cohort triage hint CONFIRMED and the work-seeking selection REFUTED as an understatement: four separate D9 triggers are present, not one. Employment-selected, so the sample does not enter the primary prevalence synthesis. No whole-cohort arm row was created: the experimental intervention was explicitly aimed at vocational outcomes, which fails the SAP 2.1 safeguard, and no whole-cohort employment count is printed in any case.

title: Untreated illness and recovery in clients of an early psychosis intervention program: a 10-year prospective cohort study
cohort_overlap_notes: PEPP London, Ontario also generates mackinley2022, which is not in the frozen screening set (D10.1). This cohort was admitted March 1997 to February 2002, a distinct era, so the triage note's era claim is confirmed.
notes: Cohort triage hint CONFIRMED, and the '35/65 at 10y' figure confirmed as Table 2's employment status at 10-year follow-up. A second, broader result is also present and separately extracted: 32/65 engaged in work and/or school for all 52 weeks of the past year, which is threshold-defined and does not identify the unthresholded composite.

title: Cognitive predictors and genetic moderators of employment outcomes in people with schizophrenia
cohort_overlap_notes: Baseline data come from NIMH CTNB studies NCT00001247 and NCT00001486; the size of the source sample from which the 124 recontacted individuals were drawn is not reported, so overlap with other reports of NIMH intramural samples cannot be assessed.
notes: Cohort triage hint CONFIRMED. Triage note 'count not stated' REFUTED: Table 1 prints 'Employed - Follow-up Visit n = 56 (45.2 %)', corroborated exactly by the employment-change cross-classification. No back-calculation was needed. Triage note on the variable recontact interval CONFIRMED and coded calendar_end_common under D12.8.

title: The influence of clinical and sociodemographic variables on employment and education for Danish youth with a psychotic disorder: a population-based national registry study
cohort_overlap_notes: CROSS-TRACKS covers the Central Denmark Region and draws on the same national sources (DREAM, Danish National Patient Registry, CPR) as whole-country Danish register reports in this review, so participants resident in the Central Region may appear in both.
notes: Cohort triage hint CONFIRMED, and the composite construct CONFIRMED as employment OR education, so not paid_any. The triage note names only the 5-year result; a 3-year result (505/2577) is also printed and is extracted as a second row. The cohort is additionally employment-SELECTED under D9, which the triage note did not carry: individuals on disability pension at baseline were excluded from the study population.

title: Rates and predictors of 18-months remission in an epidemiological cohort of 661 patients with first-episode psychosis
cohort_overlap_notes: FEPOS: the same 661 EPPIC patients as Conus 2007 (ref 21, baseline paper) and the 643 of Lambert 2005 (ref 22). Shares a site but not an era with other EPPIC/Orygen cohorts in this review.
notes: Cohort triage hint CONFIRMED, and the broad construct CONFIRMED: the MVSI composite counts paid or unpaid employment, students, homemakers and volunteers, so it is vocational_activity, not paid_any. A second problem the triage note did not carry: the endpoint is discharge or last file entry, with time in service from under 1 week to 208 weeks, so the printed '18 months' is not an elapsed follow-up common to the cohort.
